package.name: trnav_2ws_motion
package.description: AMR Motion - QD (Quad-Drive diagonal) platform-specific library: TwoWsPathController, TwoWsMpcController, TwoWsWheelSetPacker, TwoWsActionServerBase. Kinematics (TwoWsDualSteerIK/TwoWsCrabIK/TwoWsBicycleModel) moved to trnav_2ws_kinematics (src/Control/Motion_Control/2WS/trnav_2ws_kinematics) per the ADR-012 amendment of 2026-07-04. Depends on trnav_2ws_core for platform-agnostic primitives.
